summary.text: As CMS Administrator, Oz has said AI is part of modernizing healthcare and putting patients first, including by cutting red tape and reducing paperwork (s3, s4). In a March 2025 statement, Oz said AI can free doctors and nurses from paperwork so they can focus more on patients (s7). Oz has cited harnessing AI alongside efforts to reduce fraud, waste, and abuse (s5). In a reported statement, Oz said that short term AI will be inflationary because it can turbocharge current billing systems, while a September 2026 CMS press release quoted him describing ACCESS as giving patients and providers greater access to AI-enabled technologies (s9, s11).
